besluite.fout: 'meer as groot en klein' without 'net' reads oddly as a contrast in Afrikaans.
besluite.rede: 'meer as net groot en klein' is the natural form and the meaning is unchanged; the heading is not touched.

besluite.fout: "'n stad se baie mense" is a wooden possessive and the fronted 'Elke dag koop' is stiff.
besluite.rede: Same people, same action, same time, in natural word order.

besluite.fout: 'het mense nodig om te werk' is roundabout and can be read as needing people in order to work.
besluite.rede: 'het werkers nodig' says the same thing plainly and fits the next sentence about asking for work.

besluite.fout: Comma before 'en' between parts of one phrase, against the AWS 2017 as this pipeline applies it.
besluite.rede: No comma before 'en' when it does not join two sentences with their own subject and verb; the meaning is unchanged.
Predicative 'ver' at the end of the sentence is ordinary, natural Afrikaans, so 'ver weg' is only a lateral move.

besluite.fout: The run of 'en ... en ... en' makes a plain list read childishly.
besluite.rede: The normal list form with commas and one final 'en' keeps all four items and the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'terwyl hulle werk en 'n vaste huis soek' can be read as 'while they work' or as 'while they look for work'.
besluite.rede: The ambiguity is real, but the proposal settles it to one of the two readings, and which one is meant is for the writer to decide.

besluite.fout: 'hulle' points back to 'almal' in the sentence about those who do not move away, so it is unclear who comes back.
besluite.rede: Saying 'those who move away' fixes the reference, keeps the quantifier 'Party' and adds no fact; the comma between the two verbs is correct.

besluite.fout: 'in albei plekke' is the wrong preposition; Afrikaans says 'op 'n plek'.
besluite.rede: It is the same meaning (having a house at both locations) with the idiomatic preposition.

besluite.fout: Work and services do not 'staan'; the verb fits buildings, not work.
besluite.rede: 'bymekaar is' is the plain verb and matches the lesson's own heading and the urban block, and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: In the definition, 'in gemeenskappe en op plase' trails after the comparison and dangles.
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition shared word for word across lessons, so the word order may change only through the writer.
